title: Choose the platform built for your water.
body: ASSAULT and HALO share the same KAIZURO development philosophy, but they are engineered for different line classes, lure ranges and offshore pressure.

columns.body: Built for heavy topwater casting, large GT, tuna, kingfish, dogtooth tuna and other large pelagics.
A heavier expedition platform for giant GT, very large tuna and extreme offshore pressure.
